Notes

  • Only the entry prices are published as text: Essentials from $19.95/mo, Pro from $89.95/mo. Other tier prices sit behind the volume slider and were not readable, so larger volumes use the entry tier plus its published overage rate and may overstate cost.
  • Published overage per extra email: Essentials 50K $0.0013, Essentials 100K $0.0009, Pro 100K $0.0011, Pro 300K $0.0009, Pro 700K $0.0008, Pro 1.5M $0.0006, Pro 2.5M $0.0005.
  • Pro includes 1 dedicated IP.
